user.title: Connect your Puri Nixie Clock
user.description: Enter the address of the clock on your network. The Local API has no authentication, so only use this on a trusted network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the clock. A fixed address is recommended.

reconfigure.title: Change the address of the clock
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of this clock.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the clock.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the clock. Check the address and that the clock is on.
error.invalid_response: The device answered, but not like a Puri Nixie Clock.
error.unsupported_model: This clock model is not supported. Only the Puri 4-tube and 6-tube are.

abort.wrong_device: This is a different clock than the one being reconfigured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The address of the clock was updated.

data.min_elevation: Automatic brightness: sun elevation for the darkest step (°)
data.max_elevation: Automatic brightness: sun elevation for the brightest step (°)

data_description.scan_interval: How often the clock is read, from 15 to 300 seconds.
data_description.display_on_day: Used when the display is switched on and there is no remembered or automatic brightness.
data_description.min_value: Lowest brightness automatic brightness uses. Switching the display off is done with the display switch.
data_description.min_elevation: At or below this solar elevation the darkest step is used.
data_description.max_elevation: At or above this solar elevation the brightest step is used.

error.value_range: The darkest step must not be brighter than the brightest step.
error.elevation_range: The elevation for the darkest step must be lower than the one for the brightest step.
